procedures.title: Review the cabin air monitor
procedures.purpose: Verify the source of the environmental reading and record a handoff for the affected zone.

steps.title: Check the breathing environment
steps.instruction: Read the zone and timestamp in the incident evidence. Compare them with the crew locations at the time of the observation.

steps.title: Verify the source
steps.instruction: Review the air monitor identifier and signal quality. Record the observation as unverified if you cannot confirm its source.

steps.title: Record the handoff
steps.instruction: Assign a crew member to follow up. Use Request support when local help is needed. Record completion when the information is ready for review.

procedures.title: Check the sensor connection
procedures.purpose: Verify the data source and record missing, delayed or degraded readings.

steps.title: Identify the monitor
steps.instruction: In Profiles → Sensors, find the equipment assigned to the crew member or zone. Compare its ID with the incident evidence when available.

steps.title: Look for a current reading
steps.instruction: Compare the measurement and reception times. Check the status of each reading. If you cannot verify the data, pause the check or request support.

steps.title: Record the result
steps.instruction: Confirm that you reviewed the connection. Leave any unresolved readings for the assigned follow-up.

procedures.title: Review a crew concern
procedures.purpose: Save the available information for the crew medical officer.

steps.title: Review the report
steps.instruction: Confirm the crew member, time and stated concern.

steps.title: Review recent context
steps.instruction: Look at the available personal readings, activity and breathing environment. Flag any missing information.

steps.title: Arrange follow-up
steps.instruction: Record the review when the information is ready. You can assign a reviewer and request support if needed.

procedures.title: Review assigned equipment
procedures.purpose: Record the equipment check before the scheduled exterior task.

steps.title: Check the assigned device
steps.instruction: Confirm the wrist monitor listed in Profiles is assigned to the crew member preparing for EVA.

steps.title: Record equipment readiness
steps.instruction: Record whether you completed the equipment check. Use the mission’s separate authorization process for EVA clearance.

procedures.title: Complete the post-EVA check-in
procedures.purpose: Capture how the crew member feels and review available measurements after the return.

steps.title: Confirm return context
steps.instruction: Review the updated location and breathing environment for the returning crew member.

steps.title: Check in with the crew member
steps.instruction: Ask if there is a concern. Use Report a concern to record it alongside the telemetry.

steps.title: Record the check-in
steps.instruction: Complete the task after the check-in. Leave any concern open for its own review.
